Which functions or methods in the click library (src/click/) directly call both the style function from src/click/termui.py and the echo function from src/click/utils.py? Give the symbol ID.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query finds all function/method symbols in the click library directory that have direct call edges to both the 'style' function from termui.py and the 'echo' function from utils.py. WHERE f1.file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE file_name LIKE '%/click/%')
